evidence.sql:
WITH grouped AS (
            SELECT
                DATE_TRUNC(DATE(`fecha`), MONTH) AS period,
                SUM(`inv_neta`) AS value,
                COUNT(*) AS source_rows,
                MIN(DATE(`fecha`)) AS _observed_start, MAX(DATE(`fecha`)) AS _observed_end
            FROM `nexuslatam-master.NEXUS_GROUPM_BI_2.tb_data_bicompetitive`
             WHERE DATE(`fecha`) >= @start_date AND DATE(`fecha`) <= @end_date
            GROUP BY period
        ),
        scored AS (
            SELECT
                period,
                value,
                source_rows,
                DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY value DESC) AS rank,
                SUM(value) OVER () AS total,
                MIN(_observed_start) OVER () AS _observed_start, MAX(_observed_end) OVER () AS _observed_end,
                SAFE_MULTIPLY(
                    SAFE_DIVIDE(value, SUM(value) OVER ()),
                    100
                ) AS share_of_total_pct
            FROM grouped
            WHERE value IS NOT NULL
        )
        SELECT
            period,
            value,
            source_rows,
            rank,
            share_of_total_pct,
            rank = 1 AS is_peak, total, _observed_start, _observed_end
        FROM scored
        ORDER BY period

WITH grouped AS (
            SELECT
                UPPER(TRIM(CAST(`medio` AS STRING))) AS dimension,
                SUM(`inv_neta`) AS value,
                COUNT(*) AS source_rows,
                MIN(DATE(`fecha`)) AS _observed_start, MAX(DATE(`fecha`)) AS _observed_end
            FROM `nexuslatam-master.NEXUS_GROUPM_BI_2.tb_data_bicompetitive`
             WHERE DATE(`fecha`) >= @start_date AND DATE(`fecha`) <= @end_date
            GROUP BY dimension
        ),
        scored AS (
            SELECT
                dimension,
                value,
                source_rows,
                DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY value DESC) AS rank,
                SUM(value) OVER () AS total,
                MIN(_observed_start) OVER () AS _observed_start, MAX(_observed_end) OVER () AS _observed_end,
                SAFE_MULTIPLY(
                    SAFE_DIVIDE(value, SUM(value) OVER ()),
                    100
                ) AS share_pct
            FROM grouped
            WHERE value IS NOT NULL
        )
        SELECT
            dimension,
            value,
            source_rows,
            rank,
            share_pct, total, _observed_start, _observed_end,
            SUM(POW(SAFE_DIVIDE(value, total), 2)) OVER () * 10000 AS concentration_hhi,
            SUM(IF(dimension IS NULL OR CAST(dimension AS STRING) IN ('', 'N/A', 'UNKNOWN', 'NULL', 'DESCONOCIDO'), value, 0)) OVER () AS unknown_value
        FROM scored
        ORDER BY value DESC, CAST(dimension AS STRING)
        LIMIT @limit

events.reason: La evidencia muestra que la inversión neta en el periodo mayo-julio 2026 totaliza 64,336,156.60, con un pico en junio (21,744,922.66) y una tendencia ligeramente creciente (+3.05% de mayo a julio). Por medio, RADIO lidera con 39.65%, seguido de DIGITAL (26.29%) y VIA PUBLICA (22.59%). Por marca, 360 FITNESS es la primera con 17.36%, SMART FIT segunda con 16.31% y TECHNOGYM tercera con 12.59%. La concentración es alta en medios (HHI 2,798) y moderada en marcas (HHI 928.5). No se detectan anomalías. Para profundizar en el 'cómo vamos', se sugiere comparar este trimestre con el mismo periodo de 2025 para evaluar crecimiento o declive interanual.
